resources.string: The first attempt did not finish on this phone. Continue to safely resume it.
Enter the pairing code shown in Nodus web.
Connected to %1$s. Start synchronization when you are ready.

Review this retained local scope? Current synchronization will disconnect. This does not restore credentials or activate anything. Reuse requires separate credential validation, an equal authenticated server realm ID, and explicit same-account confirmation.
The result of %1$d changes could not be confirmed.
Connected. Synchronization has not completed yet.
Device paired securely. Synchronization remains inactive until you confirm activation.
Pending pairing cancelled. If its earlier outcome was unknown, revoke any unexpected device from Nodus web before creating another code.
The pairing code is invalid, expired, or belongs to an earlier server realm. Create a new code in Nodus web.
This pairing code was already used with different device evidence. Review paired devices in Nodus web and create a new code.
Too many pairing attempts. Wait before trying again.
The server is in recovery mode and cannot pair devices yet.
Finish or cancel the saved pairing attempt before starting another.
The saved pairing attempt belongs to a different server. Start over to connect here.
Check the HTTPS server address and complete pairing code.
The phone could not find this Nodus server. Check the server address, DNS and network connection.
The Nodus server did not respond in time.
The phone could not establish a secure HTTPS connection to this Nodus server.
The phone could not connect to this Nodus server. Check mobile data or Wi-Fi.
Pairing could not be completed. Check your connection, then choose Continue pairing.
Nodus could not reach the server.
Nodus could not validate this action.
Nodus could not complete this action.
Start over with a new pairing code? Only do this if you no longer want to continue the saved attempt.
Remove this connection from the phone? Your notes and saved changes will remain.
Start synchronizing shared notes with this server? Notes marked local-only will stay on this phone.
Pause synchronization? Your notes and saved changes will remain.
Use the proposed change? Nodus will apply it to the latest server version.
Keep the current version and discard the proposed change?
